plan.title: docs: teach consumers the work-selection fork (ordered plan vs ranked queue)

narratives.Description: Document the two work-selection paths after #2402: operator-ordered plan (plan-sequence:*) vs ranked triage queue. Expand AGENTS/#1149 pointer, add commands.md Two paths subsection, open triage skill with the fork, and add one triage:welcome/consumer-header orientation line. Optional authoring skill is out of scope.
narratives.Overview:
## Problem

Ordered-plan is implemented and agent-enforced but discoverability is thin; consumers mostly see queue-only surfaces.

## Contract one-liner

Directive does not guess your mix. Either you name the next units in order (ordered plan), or you let the ranked backlog suggest (queue). Labels bias the queue; they do not override an active plan.

## Non-goals

No new label taxonomy; no auto portfolio balancer; no AGENTS bulk dump of full #2402 semantics; optional plan-sequence authoring skill deferred.
narratives.UserStory: As a consumer operator or agent, I want an explicit work-selection fork (ordered plan vs ranked queue), so that "what's next?" does not silently widen past a bounded plan or leave plan-sequence as maintainer lore.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Edit content/templates/agents-entry.md Cache-as-authoritative work selection (#1149) pointer: add ~1 sentence naming ordered plan (plan-sequence:*) vs ranked triage queue and pointing to commands.md section Backlog Triage; run task agents:refresh so AGENTS.md managed section updates (#1309).
2. Edit content/commands.md section Backlog Triage: add a short Two paths subsection covering when to use which path, plan-sequence:set/current/advance/clear/verify, exhaustion fail-closed, explicit queue escape phrases (what is the queue / build a cohort), and that mix/balance is authoring-time not runtime auto-balance.
3. Edit the triage skill source (content/packs/skills/skills-pack-0.1.json slice for deft-directive-triage, then task packs:render OR edit content/skills/deft-directive-triage/SKILL.md if that is the editable surface): open with the fork before Phase 2; ensure what-next triggers are not queue-only; keep plan-sequence:current check as the first gate.
4. Add one orientation line to triage:welcome output path and/or consumer header template (content/templates/agents-entry.md unmanaged/onboarding surface as applicable): default is ranked queue; lock a short ordered plan for bounded delivery.
5. Add CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] brief docs entry closing #2542.
Verification: task agents:refresh; task check (or docs/content gates that apply); spot-read AGENTS.md managed section + commands.md + triage skill for the fork.
narratives.Acceptance:
1. AGENTS pointer names two modes + commands.md pointer; agents:refresh clean
2. commands.md Two paths subsection
3. triage skill opens with fork
4. welcome/header orientation line
5. CHANGELOG closes #2542

narrative.Acceptance: Given AGENTS managed section / agents-entry, when a consumer reads the #1149/#2402 work-selection line, then it names ordered plan vs ranked queue and points to commands.md § Backlog Triage; task agents:refresh succeeds.

Given content/commands.md § Backlog Triage, when an operator reads Two paths, then it covers when to use which, set/current/advance/clear/verify, exhaustion fail-closed, queue escape phrases, and authoring-time mix (not runtime auto-balance).

Given deft-directive-triage and triage:welcome/consumer header, when an agent starts triage or onboarding, then the fork is stated before Phase 2 and onboarding has one ranked-queue-default / ordered-plan-for-bounded-delivery line.
Given CHANGELOG [Unreleased], when released, then a brief user-facing docs entry closes #2542.

expected_outputs: Two-path work-selection framing in AGENTS pointer + commands.md + triage skill + welcome/header
